verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 is a data-center AI accelerator. It ships inside DGX systems built 'purpose-built for all AI infrastructure and workloads from analytics to training to inference.' Consumer 4K high-refresh gaming is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships gaming capability or game benchmarks.

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks
